toolbar.askTitle: Ask about the selection in the side panel

bubble.pin: Pin panel (won't scroll with the page or close on outside click)

translate.failed: Translation failed. Check your network or switch engines

ai.extensionUpdated: The extension was updated. Refresh the page and try again

translateToEnglish.name: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.prompt: Translate the selection into natural, idiomatic English. Keep code, proper nouns, and formatting as is. Output only the translation, no explanations.

explainError.name: Explain the error
explainError.prompt: The selection is an error message or log. Start with one sentence on what went wrong, then list troubleshooting and fix steps from most to least likely, with example code where it helps.

toJson.name: Convert to JSON
toJson.prompt: Organize the selection into clean, well-structured JSON: infer suitable field names (lower camelCase, in English) and types from the content. Output only the JSON itself — no code fences, no explanations.
